author: Akien
prose: a while back, yesterday sometime, i recall seeing a thing go by about how the ground loop wasn't going like once a second or anything. i move we make them once a minute. if that's too short we'll make it every 5 minutes. no way that's too short. and we just design everything to fit that. if i need something at 2:31.7 seconds after the pulse, i can have the probe that's triggered by the ground loop spin up other handlers.
